name: 役職手当・固定手当 (fixed allowance)
authority: 健康保険法 art.3(5) and 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iii) (報酬), 雇用保険法 art.4(4) (賃金) and 所得税法 art.28 (給与所得): a fixed allowance is remuneration, salary income and in the overtime base. A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.

name: 家族手当 (family allowance)
authority: Remuneration for social insurance (健保法 art.3(5)), wages for employment insurance and salary income; left out of the overtime base only where it is set by the number of dependants (terms.facts.family_allowance_by_dependants; 労働基準法 art.37(5), 施行規則 art.21; 昭和22年11月5日 基発231号): a flat amount paid regardless of family is in the base. A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.

name: 住宅手当 (housing allowance)
authority: Remuneration, wages and salary income; excluded from the overtime base only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法施行規則 art.21(iii), 平成11年3月31日 基発170号). A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.

name: 通勤手当 (commuting allowance)
authority: 所得税法 art.9(1)(v) with 施行令 art.20の2: the reasonable public-transport fare up to 150,000 a month, or the car limits by one-way distance (terms.facts commute_car_km_one_way, commute_parking_fee, commute_transit_fare), are not taxable (INCOME_TAX.COMMUTING: only the excess is taxed); it is remuneration for social insurance (健保法 art.3(5)) and wages for labour insurance. A commuter pass paid for several months is the ad hoc COMMUTER_PASS. A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days. It is left out of the overtime base only where it is set by the distance or the actual cost (terms.facts.commuting_allowance_by_distance; 労働基準法 art.37(5); 昭和23年2月20日 基発297号).

name: 精皆勤手当 (attendance allowance)
authority: 健康保険法 art.3(5), 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iii) (報酬), 雇用保険法 art.4(4) (賃金), 所得税法 art.28 (給与所得) and in the overtime base (労働基準法 art.37(5) does not exclude it); excluded from the wage compared with the minimum wage (最低賃金法 art.4(3)(iii) with 施行規則 art.1(2)(i)). A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.
